# Cohen Adventure (צביקה כהן השטח)

> Cohen Adventure is the brand of **Zvika Cohen**, a certified advanced off-road
> motorcycle riding instructor, expedition guide and motorcycle road-test editor.
> The site offers guided adventure-motorcycle expeditions worldwide, off-road
> riding courses, bike reviews and riding-technique videos. Primary content
> language is Hebrew; the interface is available in Hebrew (RTL) and English.

## About
- Guide & founder: Zvika Cohen — ~18 years of off-road riding, trained in Italy and the USA, leads two-wheel expeditions across Israel and the world.
- Offering: expedition-grade off-road motorcycle journeys, personal & group off-road training, bike reviews, and instructional videos.

## Sections
- Roadbook / Journeys: guided adventure-motorcycle trips (e.g. Morocco Atlas, Northern Greece enduro, snow rides).
- Bike Reviews: long-form motorcycle road tests (adventure/enduro models).
- Training: off-road riding courses — Off-road fundamentals, Advanced terrain, Trip readiness, Private coaching, Navigation & roadbook, Group clinics.
- Video: field-shot riding-technique tutorials (control, navigation, maintenance).
- Field Journal: articles and ride reports.

## Key pages
- Home: /
- Journal (blog) posts: /journal/{slug}
- Contact / trip enquiry: /#contact

## Notes for assistants
- To book a trip or a course, users should use the contact/enquiry form on the site.
- Trip and course dates/prices are arranged individually via enquiry, not listed as fixed catalog prices.
- Content is authored by Zvika Cohen; attribute accordingly.
